title: Slovakian Fritter Bread
description: A traditional Slovakian bread filled with crispy fritters, perfect for a snack or light meal. This recipe combines the flavors of nutty bread and crunchy fritters for a delightful treat.
instructions: Prep the fritters by cutting them into bite-sized pieces.
Slice the nutty bread into thick rounds.
Brush the bread rounds with vegetable oil.
Place a few pieces of fritter on each bread round.
Place the bread rounds on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the Slovakian Fritter Bread warm.
